biography.en:
**Name In Native Language:** 下川林

**Also Known As:**
Shimokawa (下川)
Shimokawa Bokuko (下川僕子)

Chinese. She majored in oil painting for her undergraduate degree, but later chose to study in Japan, shifting her focus from fine art to manga creation. Now, she publishes her work in manga magazines and lives there as a professional manga artist. She says she “doesn't really like being in the business”, preferring to draw peacefully within the editorial and publishing system; she also says “drawing manga is really tiring”, but it's precisely because of the pain that she feels it's worthwhile.

Her works often carry a touch of the eerie. “It's not that I intentionally wanted to draw horror comics, it's just that as I was drawing, everyone felt a bit scared.”. From China to Japan, from painting abstract oil paintings to storyboards, she has always been searching for a way to truely “know what she is drawing”. ([Source](https://podcasts.apple.com/cn/podcast/ep44-%E4%B8%8B%E5%B7%9D%E6%9E%97-%E6%BC%AB%E7%94%BB%E4%B9%9F%E5%8F%AF%E4%BB%A5%E4%B8%8D%E6%98%AF%E6%A2%A6-%E6%98%AF%E4%B8%80%E4%BB%BD%E5%90%83%E9%A5%AD%E7%9A%84%E5%B7%A5%E4%BD%9C/id1794024476?i=1000732574629))

title.en: Pure Youth: Red, Pink and Green Grapefruit

description.en: Lan Yijie, who attends a cram school to get into college, has a falling out with Sun Haohan from No.1 Middle School from the beginning and they are irreconcilable. In fact, Ah Han really wants to establish a good relationship with Xiaojie, but he always says one thing and means another, and misses the opportunity... The cram school roll call, the date after class, the pure love battle between the young man and woman START! !

A twisted love reminiscent of the Cowherd and the Weaver Girl!
A fallen celestial maiden encounters a handsome woodcutter.
A charming “prince” rescues her—supposedly just to win her heart…
But is that really all there is to it?
What’s the meaning behind the villagers’ sly grins?
And what’s going on with that locked cellar?
A dark fairy tale about a celestial maiden searching for her feathered robe is about to unfold!
description.zh: 漫画简介: 【KK原创投稿计划】 牛郎织女式的诡谲爱恋!落难仙女遭遇帅气樵夫，白马王子出手相救只为得到她的芳心……真的只是如此吗？村民的嬉皮笑脸有什么深意？上锁的地窖又是怎么一回事？仙女寻找羽衣的暗黑童话即将展开！

description.en: Hoop-rolling, marbles, beanbags, rubber-band skipping, slingshots, spinning tops, flower cards… Just hearing these names—doesn’t it already bring back a flood of childhood memories? That’s right: Hei Bei is pouring his heart into a feast of the most authentic childhood nostalgia for those born in the late ’70s, the ’80s, and the early ’90s. Here are the shared memories of a whole generation—and that first, pure happiness you’ll want to revisit whenever life gets you down. Please don’t forget the beauty we once had.
description.zh: 桶箍、弹球、沙包、皮筋、弹弓、陀螺、花牌……光提这些是不是已经勾起了你的很多童年回忆？没错，黑背将倾情为70末、80后、还有90初生人献上最原汁原味的童年回忆盛宴！这里有一代人共同的童年回忆，还有郁闷时都要重温的初快乐！请不要忘记曾经的美好！

description.en:
A game of romance that may prove to be fatal!

Detective Winnie Kiu entered a virtual game while in pursuit of a murderer. She put her life on the line and relied on Code Guest's help to save seven princes trapped in the game. Solving cases in the real world and adventuring in the game world, romance is everywhere in this intense and exciting game. The seven princes await their master's arrival!

Hundreds of sky-reaching giant towers suddenly popped up all over the world, and the land sank. In order not to be submerged by the sea, people had to squeeze into the towers and climb up. Do you have to sacrifice others if you want to survive?
The Eight-Star Alliance has launched their invasion. But as Five mysterious Earths appear, fate takes an unexpected turn. When the Five Stars finally unite… disaster will descend upon all realms!
description.zh: 八星联军入侵，五个地球？五星齐聚，灾祸降临！

description.en:
Girl's horror manhua…

The artist is a fan of movies like Hellraiser. Be prepared for some pretty shocking scenes and tense story.

*~Please let me gently play that broken and desolate song of sadness~*

There is a free soul in Xiao Wu's body, that is his brother who he can see in the mirror, a man who is stronger than him; when Xiao Wu is bullied by others, his brother will come out to protect him, always. After the death of his parents and hurting his classmates, Xiao Wu received many years of mental treatment, and finally came out in high school... There he met a girl who looked like his mother, and he wanted to keep her by his side forever.

After years of chasing his dream of becoming an artist, Zhu Chengming finally decides to give it up. However, he soon discovers a difficult question: Is life after abandoning your passion truly as easy and relaxed as he imagined it would be?

description.en: Gu Tianze became the general manager because of his ability to hear other people's inner thoughts. He thought his life should be smooth sailing, but he accidentally heard that the person who came to apply for the secretary job wanted to kill him.

altTitles.en: A TS Situation with a little problem

description.en:
Sixty years after the end of a major war that changed human history, peace has once again been restored to human society. But behind the prosperous development, the dark forces are stirring and ready to start the war again......
At the same time, a young girl with special abilities. In order to find her mother's murderer, Aramaki Neko takes up the blade of revenge and becomes a hunter specialized in hunting the "blood clans" who hide in the night and feed on humans!
description.zh-hk: 在經過改變人類歷史的重大戰爭結束六十年後，人類社會再次恢復了和平。但在繁榮發展的背後，黑暗的勢力正蠢蠢欲動，準備再次掀起戰亂……同時，擁有特殊能力的少女．荒牧寢子為了找出殺母仇人，拿起了復仇的刀刃，成為了專門狩獵隱藏在黑夜中，以人類為食的「血族」的狩獵者！

description.en: A strange illness known as Dream Syndrome is spreading through the city. Those afflicted fall into various dreams and cannot wake up. To save these patients, a new profession has quietly emerged, known as the Dream Masters.

description.es-la: Yang Sheng, un oficinista urbano de 28 años, es engañado para que vuelva a su pueblo natal y organizarle una cita a ciegas. Él, que ha decidido quedarse soltero porque no puede enamorarse de mujeres, conoce a su vecino Wen Xiaoxue, un joven que sufre violencia por parte de su padre. Movido por la compasión, Yang Sheng se lo lleva de su pueblo natal. Los dos forman una familia peculiar, y a través de la comida y los pequeños momentos de la vida, van experimentando poco a poco la felicidad cotidiana. Sin embargo, las sombras de sus familias de origen siguen acosándolos sin descanso. Al mismo tiempo, a medida que Wen Xiaoxue crece, entre los dos empieza a brotar un sentimiento extraño...

description.en: A traveler comes across a memorial pillar. Why is it so dilapidated now?

description.en:
A crack ship that trended for half a year — and now the real people finally meet! One’s a famous movie star. The other? A chill, low-key idol. Two people with zero overlap, no connection whatsoever... yet thanks to a random crackship post on a fan forum, they suddenly blew up online as a pair?! Our socially anxious little idol just wants to stay far, far away — but fate has other plans, and the two unexpectedly cross paths! What kind of sparks will fly between this “CP born on the internet”? 

(CP stands for "couple" (or character pairing) and not the other term)

description.en: Lu Chen, an immortal young man, was trapped in the Land of Desolation for over ten million years. After thousands of centuries of meticulous planning, he finally managed to escape... only to find a world vastly different from the one he remembered. The Old Continent had broken into countless pieces, the North and South Poles had been reversed, and the nine suns in the sky had been reduced to a single one; the oceans had sunk dozens of meters deep, huge and powerful prehistoric beasts had all but disappeared, and humans, who millions of years ago were only a small nation of tribesmen, had by now conquered the surface of the Earth. And that's not all: the mangy dog he had picked up by chance is now the leader of a sect, the little girl he had adopted out of kindness has become a fairy of a heavenly realm, and his disciple, whom he had been forced to take in, has become the Celestial Emperor.
description.zh: 陆尘，一个不朽的少年，被困在荒芜之地一千万年之久。经过数千年的精心策划，他终于逃脱……却发现世界已与记忆中截然不同。旧大陆崩塌成无数碎片，南北极颠倒，天上的九个太阳合而为一；海洋下沉数十米，庞大而强大的史前巨兽几乎绝迹，而数百万年前还只是少数部落的人类，如今已征服了地球表面。不仅如此，他偶然捡到的那条脏兮兮的狗，如今已是宗门的首领；他出于好心收养的小女孩，如今已是天界仙子；而他被迫收留的弟子，如今已是天帝。
description.pt-br: Lu Chen, um jovem imortal, ficou preso na Terra da Desolação por mais de dez milhões de anos. Após milhares de séculos de planejamento meticuloso, ele finalmente conseguiu escapar... apenas para encontrar um mundo vastamente diferente daquele que se lembrava. O Velho Continente havia se fragmentado em inúmeros pedaços, os polos Norte e Sul haviam sido invertidos e os nove sóis no céu haviam sido reduzidos a um único; os oceanos haviam afundado dezenas de metros, enormes e poderosas bestas pré-históricas praticamente desapareceram e os humanos, que milhões de anos atrás eram apenas uma pequena nação de tribos, agora haviam conquistado a superfície da Terra. E não é só isso: o cachorro sarnento que ele encontrou por acaso agora é o líder de uma seita, a garotinha que ele adotou por bondade se tornou uma fada de um reino celestial e seu discípulo, a quem ele foi forçado a acolher, se tornou o Imperador Celestial.

Even worse, he soon discovers that he isn't the only guy caught in this bizarre situation. Now a whole group of former male otaku must fight monsters while desperately trying to find a way to turn back into men. Thus begins their ridiculous and chaotic life as magical girls.

description.en:
A Malaysian Comic

Exploring, Enquiring, Creating

Determined to establish himself as the premier explorer, Alex, accompanied by half-cat half-human, Lulu, encounters danger, wonder, and weirdness with each adventure. Tag along with our dynamic duo as they unearth forgotten ruins, solve impenetrable mysteries, and experience experiences exceeding every expectation!

This work recounts Hei Bei’s (the author’s) “reform” journey from elementary school through junior high, so you’ll finally understand that the highest realm of sword practice is: “no sword in hand, yet a sword in the heart.” In other words, it’s the story of a weak little troublemaking kid who, to avoid being bullied, works hard to become the kind of troublemaking kid who bullies others…

This book also presents the most dangerous, nonstop, parody “ultimate moves” ever. Unless someone is truly vile beyond redemption, do not mess with them like this! If it isn’t an unforgivable offense, remember to show mercy. Good kids, well-behaved kids—please don’t imitate any of it!
description.zh: 本作讲述了黑背（作者）从小学到初中的感化事迹，让你真正懂得练剑的最高境界就是“手中无剑，心中有剑”。其实就是弱鸡熊孩子为了不被欺负，努力变为欺负别人的熊孩子的故事。。 本作是史上最危险的不断恶搞绝招！如果不是十恶不赦的人物，千万不要如此整他！如果并非不可饶恕的过错，一定记得手下留情！好孩子乖孩子切勿模仿！

description.en: Magic can help people achieve extraordinary things, but it can also bewitch hearts and bring destruction. Due to years of misuse of magic, the world is ravaged. To stop the collapse, humanity launched the "War of Sealing Magic," and after a long and fierce battle, finally defeated the Magic King, Gumur, ending the age of magic. However, the wounds left by magic are difficult to erase, so humanity established the "Demon Sealing Bureau," to both purge the remaining demons and repair this ravaged world...

While the Tianwang Team’s players and fans are still basking in the joy of winning the 2024 season championship of the D3 Second Health League and being promoted to the D2 Asia Health League, the team’s ace pitcher Marco Garcia unexpectedly falls into a psychological crisis of being “overlooked.”
Once plagued by severe self-doubt and a loss of confidence, Garcia must confront and overcome his inner psychological barriers.
Can he break through himself and reclaim his place as the true trump card in the hearts of both the Tianwang Team and its fans?

title.en: Genius Cute Baby: Heaven-Defying Mother Is Hacking Again

altTitles.zh: 天才萌宝：逆天娘亲又开挂了

description.en: On her wedding night, she was betrayed and harmed by a scoundrel, forcing her to survive in the lower realm. He has returned through reincarnation, devoted entirely to the affairs of the state, yet harboring deep, hidden personal motives. One is a Dragon Lady of the lower realm, the other is a reincarnated Phoenix Lord; both entered a partnership and a fake marriage solely to further their own agendas, finding nothing but mutual dislike in one another. However, why does the little phoenix still in the womb feel like pink bubbles of romance are starting to pop up between them?

description.en: FLUFFY LAND is an original project by GoodSmile China. This is a collection of the FLUFFY LAND manga chapters posted on the official FLUFFY LAND Twitter.

In this world, career magical girls have it easy, and are entrusted with the mission of protecting the world. However, away from the limelight, there is another type of magical girls — part-time magical girls. They have no insurance and no money, no mandated breaks or minimum wage. Despite this, they still hold on to their own beliefs, working this thankless job in the shadows. This is our story, and it all starts with a unknown magical girl...

The young Kan Xing, untrained in Daoist techniques, brings the genius Daoist priest Li Li to an odd escape room establishment to find his missing sister. However, the store's evil spirits far surpass their comprehension.  it all seems to suggest that untold secrets lie beyond the righteous facade of Daoism. And so, for the first time, these two youths come face to face with the complexity of human nature.

Not wanting to be bothered, Yu Xiaoyou, who suffers from social anxiety, is always mistaken for being aloof and cold. During a temporary reassignment, she meets Lin Yan, who is exceptionally skilled at social interactions. Though they are complete opposites, Yu finds herself relating to him in some ways…

description.en:
*"How much money could a woman’s face be worth?"* 

She was once queen. But when her face becomes partially disfigured in an accident, an imperial decree demotes Dongfang Ningxing to concubine. Not only that, but her younger sister takes her place as the new queen, while Dongfang Ningxing gets married off to the cold and brutal Prince Xueqin. And this second marriage is not a happy one, ending only in her death. Lucky for Dongfang Ningxing, her spirit is unwilling to fade away... it’s not her time yet! She still has work to do! So, Dongfang Ningxing gets a second chance. And this time, Dongfang Ningxing is ready. She must hone amazing talents, be the most beautiful in all the land, and must outmatch even the heavens! Will she succeed?? 

(Source: Comikey)

Jiang Miao has been feeling strange lately. Wei Yi, that classmate with the uniquely peculiar way of thinking, keeps staring at her and trying to follow her... A denpa-type straight-shooter girl vs. someone disguised as a ray of sunshine but with a dark, damp nature underneath.

description.fr:
Un jour, une jeune fille accusée d'être une sorcière est sauvée par Dolores, qui est elle-même une sorcière. Dolores demande à la jeune fille de lui offrir son sang en échange de son hébergement dans sa maison.
Ce séjour va-t-il faire naître des sentiments entre elles ?

Avertissement : lecture de droite à gauche.

description.en: A critically injured criminal named ICE is saved and rebuilt by a secret government organization into a lethal weapon. An elite thriller packed with classic action, deep shadows, and cinematic suspense. Original art by Lake Blue.
An adventure during a mountain climb.

description.en: A conspiracy net plotted against her more than twenty years ago is being cast on her which entwined him and her together. He has a strange disease which got on him for years and she's his antidote. In order to get rid of his headache, he imprisoned her at his side, but she was rebellious.

50 years before the events of the story portrayed in Monster Hunter Online, the current guildmaster of Mezeporta recounts his journey as a beginner hunter. In this tale, he describes his fateful meeting with a group of companions that would turn out to be respected as legendary heroes later on.

Rebirth and Rise: The Campus Business Woman
Aristocratic Boss Is Actually the Female High School Student

description.en:
She was originally a puppet of her family, a business spy, and an assassin that the police were pursuing. Then, she was betrayed and fell into the deep sea.

When she opened her eyes once more, she had become a normal high school student in her third year. Because of her disgraceful birth, her relatives ostracized her since she was young, while her classmates bullied her because of her low self-esteem and withdrawn nature. After her reincarnation, she became a domineering person and beat those people when they bullied her again. Others had to gamble or rely on their luck to see if a jade was valuable. However, with a powerful cheat in her hands, the Spiritual Jade Vision, she could easily detect spiritual qi in pieces of jade with one glance!

Life was comfortable, but there were jealous people all around her, and her skin crawled with every move they made!

A book that can make every downhearted person laugh out loud! Ten billion tons of dark humor, mixed with just a hint of “pervy cheekiness,” so that every lonely heart can bloom. Love life, love daydreaming! Where is happiness, where is happiness—happiness is in those young folks’ fantasies. This book’s online click count isn’t that high, only 40 million. The book’s fans—“Heimi”—aren’t that many either, only 2 million. If you don’t read “Heibei,” go back to Mars—Earth doesn’t welcome you!
description.zh: 一本能让所有失落的人都开怀大笑的书！一千万吨的黑色幽默，掺上点点的小”猥琐“，让每一颗孤独的心，都开出花来。爱生活、爱YY！快乐在哪里啊快乐在哪里，快乐在那小年轻儿的YY里，这本书网络点击率不算高，只有4000万，这本书的粉丝——黑米不算多，只有200万。不看黑背的人回火星去吧，地球不欢迎你！

description.en: Set at Yaya High School, the story centers on a student named Ganlan, whose special power—“handsomification” (帅化)—sparks turmoil on campus. Because of this condition, he is assigned to the “Special A Class”, a class packed with delinquent students. Major characters include Chengzi, a severely nearsighted girl who is immune to “handsomification”; Ziteng, a wealthy student who obsessively pursues Ganlan; and Chenpi, the school doctor who is secretly a taoist mage.
description.zh: 人究竟可以多帅呢？看了这部漫画就知道了~男主角是一个帅到可以杀人的单纯小哥，女主角却是高度近视，有趣的高中生活围绕他们展开着，然而这背后，却有着不为人知的大危机！

description.en:
While playing a dating simulation game, the male protagonist Zhao Xun is struck by electricity and becomes bound to a dating-sim system. This system not only allows him to see girls’ affection levels, but also lets him save and load progress, equip items, and effortlessly charm his way through romantic encounters.

Just when Zhao Xun believes he can use the system to reach the peak of life, the girl he successfully wins over suddenly turns yandere and tries to kill him.

Fortunately, the heroine Ling Yu, a bloodline bearer, arrives in time and kills the corrupted girl, allowing Zhao Xun to narrowly escape death. Through his conversation with Ling Yu, Zhao Xun learns the truth about ancient gods and bloodline bearers, realizing that the girl’s transformation was caused by possession from an ancient god’s soul.

Determined to save the girl, Zhao Xun resolutely reloads his save and starts over. In order to dispel the ancient god’s influence and save her life, he begins a targeted “romance strategy” to win her over once again.
description.es:
Mientras juega un juego de simulación de citas, el protagonista masculino Zhao Xun es golpeado por la electricidad y queda atado a un sistema de simulación de citas. This system not only allows him to see girls’ affection levels, but also lets him save and load progress, equip items, and effortlessly charm his way through romantic encounters.
Just when Zhao Xun believes he can use the system to reach the peak of life, the girl he successfully wins over suddenly turns yandere and tries to kill him.

Afortunadamente, la heroína Ling Yu, portadora de un linaje, llega a tiempo y mata a la chica corrupta, lo que le permite a Zhao Xun escapar por poco de la muerte. A través de su conversación con Ling Yu,
Zhao Xun learns the truth about ancient gods and bloodline bearers, realizing that the girl’s transformation was caused by possession from an ancient god’s soul.

Decidido a salvar a la niña, Zhao Xun resueltamente recarga su guardado y comienza de nuevo. Para disipar la influencia del dios antiguo y salvar su vida,
Él comienza una "estrategia romántica" específica para conquistarla una vez más.
description.zh: 男主赵循在玩恋爱养成游戏时，被电击中，身上附身恋爱养成系统，该系统不仅可以窥视女生的好感度，还可以存读档，装备道具让他的泡妹之旅无往不利。可就在男主角认为自己可以借助系统走上人生巅峰的时候，他泡到的妹子却突然黑化想要杀他。所幸身为血裔者的女主灵玉赶来，干掉了黑化的妹子，赵循才逃过一劫。在与灵雨的交谈中，赵循接触到了拥有古神和血裔者的真相，明白妹子黑化是被古神魂魄附身的缘故。为了挽救妹子的生命，赵循义无反顾的读档重来，为驱散古神魂魄挽救妹子性命，展开针对性的泡妞攻略……

description.en:
Cong Xia wakes up to a loud crash. An earthquake has struck a remote region of China. At first, nothing seems out of the ordinary—but on that very day, all food spoils, and panic spreads across the internet.

While browsing yet another forum, Cong Xia hears an insistent knock at the door and finds a handsome soldier on his doorstep, determined to take him to Beijing.

Once they step outside, they realize that animals and plants have evolved, and danger now lurks at every turn. What challenges await them, and will they be able to make it there alive?
description.ru: Цун Ся просыпается от грохота. В отдалённом районе Китая произошло землетрясение. Казалось бы, не произошло ничего сверхъестественного, но в этот же день все продукты испортились, а в интернете поднялась паника. Просматривая очередной форум, Цун Ся слышит настойчивый стук в дверь, и видит на пороге симпатичного военного, который намерен забрать его в Пекин. Выйдя за порог, они понимают, что животные и растения эволюционировали, и теперь опасность поджидает их на каждом шагу. Какие препятствия их ждут, и смогут ли они добраться живыми?
description.zh: 冷峻特种兵#成天壁 x 奶妈技术宅#丛夏 ，一路逃亡进化中的扶持，是末世里的细水长流，也是危难中的相互依靠。寒武纪降临，从食物链顶端轰然坠落的人类，将面临什么样的命运

Tinh Giáp: Mạt Thế Hung Thú, Tôi Dựa Cả Vào Ông Cố Tiếp Tế Điểm

altTitles.ru: Звездная броня: Во время апокалипсиса, когда на меня напали свирепые звери, я полностью полагалась на своего прадеда в вопросах еды

description.en: In a beast apocalypse, 14-year-old girl Song Qianqiu gets separated from her family after being attacked by ferocious beasts while searching for food. At the moment she’s about to faint from hunger, her vision blurs and a red spatial rift appears before her… This spatial rift connects to another timeline 60 years in the past, and on the other side of the rift is her great-grandfather Song Yunxiang, who begins frantically sending food through to her… (ac.qq)
description.zh: 兽潮末世，14岁的少女宋千秋在外出搜集食物时遭到凶兽袭击与家人走散，饿晕过去的瞬间眼前一花，面前竟然出现了一条红色的空间裂缝…这条空间裂缝，竟然连接着60年前的另一个时空，而裂缝的对面，是来自太爷爷宋云祥的疯狂投喂…

attributes.name: Lexiang Animation (乐想动漫乐 / Lèxiǎng Dòngmàn)

description.en:
In a city founded upon the gathering place of the country's largest group of prisons, there is a rumor: death row inmates can ascend to heaven peacefully after death only if the last meals they ate were prepared by Fan Chan, the "Deity of Prison Food".

Thus, author Yi Fan narrates a story about death and food that you have not seen before.
description.zh: 在一座靠着全国最大规模的监狱聚集地发展而来的城市里流传着一个传闻：只有吃过“牢饭仙人”范禅做的极刑饭，死刑犯才能安心升天。由此，作者一番为大家讲述一个你从未看过的关于死亡与美食的故事。

description.en: I transmigrated into a novel I wrote and became the key supporting character who's supposed to drive the two leads together (as the female lead's best friend)! Instead, I make up my mind to become the biggest obstacle to their relationship. However, all of my plans were ruined by a mysterious transfer student. Do NPCs these days come with a built-in plot accuracy feature? On top of it all, my best friend has started shipping me with the male lead. Seriously girl, wake up — you are the female lead of this novel!
description.zh: 我穿进自己写的小说中，成为推动男女主感情发展的重要配角——女主的闺蜜，但我却决定摆烂到底，立志要成为男女主感情路上最大的绊脚石。然而，所有计划却被一个神秘的转校生打乱，难不成这届NPC还自带剧情修正功能？甚至我的闺蜜还磕起了我和男主的CP？！拜托姐妹你醒醒，你才是这本小说的女主角啊！

altTitles.en: Why Should I be a Prisoner?

description.en: What? Plundering my clothes? Peeping at my secrets? Winning my trust? Deceiving my heart? Squeezing everything out of me? Threatening that you'll marry me? And in the end, I became your slave?!

A kid who used to come by the tea shop all the time is now a rising table tennis star representing Taiwan!

The tea shop owner’s son fantasizes about using his childhood friend’s celebrity status to give their struggling shop a much-needed boost. But is it really that simple? After all, they haven’t been in touch for a long time…

title.zh-ro: Piān wǒ lái shí qià féng chūn

altTitles.en: By Chance, I Arrived With the Spring

description.en:
Educated Heiress x Blind Mortician
To corrupt her widowed sister-in-law, Song Zhimei resorts to every underhanded, disgraceful trick she can think of. But one night, she mistakenly stumbles into her sister-in-law’s secret chambers.
Behind one locked door lies her long-missing elder brother. Behind another stands a gilded cage, filled with nothing but Song Zhimei’s most cherished possessions. And the sister-in-law who has always seemed so frail now blocks her path, iron chains in hand…
In the end, who will be the real prey?

title.zh-ro: Zài Shēng Yuán: Wǒ De Wēnróu Bàojūn

altTitles.en: Fate of Rebirth: My Gentle Tyrant

altTitles.ja: 私の優しいセンセイ君主

description.en:
The events that caused Zhu Qi's death in her previous life, including political strife and coups, are happening again. 

Long Feili does everything he can to rescue her after she has reincarnated once more. 

He showers her with love and affection, putting his own life on the line to keep her safe. 

Played by the strings of fate, will the two be able to safeguard their precious romance this time?

description.en: Riley, a wandering artist disguised as a maid, gets caught stealing at Hilland Manor. As guards whip her, the lady of the manor, Yasmin, unexpectedly shields her. Riley couldn’t believe her luck at the noble’s kindness until Yasmin tended her wounds and revealed hidden desires and schemes. This "rescue" was a trap all along!

After his 17-year-old brother dies in a car accident, the older brother goes to the school to retrieve his belongings, only to be trapped in a classroom by a supernatural horror and forced to follow its rules. He must now use the clues to uncover the bullying his brother endured at school, as well as how he himself caused his brother to suffer…

The alluring human, Ling Xi, infiltrates a special agent academy teaming with beastmen in the pursuit of revenge. Initially, he feels fortunate to have a powerful partner to shield him from the dangers of the beastmen around him. But little does he know, that the most dangerous beastman is none other than his partner. The tangled maintained harmony and understanding during the day crumbles under the influence of growing desire at night.

title.zh-ro: Wǒ Zěnme Kěnéng Bèi Guǐ Mí le Xīnqiào

altTitles.zh: 我怎么可能被鬼迷了心窍

description.en:
After quitting her job and moving back to her rural hometown in Northeast China, Ye Xiaoyun’s life gets turned upside down by a massive, mysterious package. She cuts it open, only to find Count Vlad III Dracula himself! Now, an ancient, immortal vampire is casually crashing at her place in the middle of nowhere. Is this a doomed curse, or the wildest twist of fate she never saw coming?

— Carbon Scans
description.zh: 辞职回到东北老家的叶晓云，突然收到一个奇怪的巨大包裹，拆开一看，里面竟是——布莱德三世德拉古拉伯爵！ 这位活了不知道多少年的吸血鬼，还就这样堂而皇之地在中国东北暂住下来？这到底是命中注定的诅咒，还是阴差阳错的孽缘？
